newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LIVIKO Q1 PROFIT UP, TO BOOST CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: LIVIKO Q1 PROFIT UP, TO BOOST CAPITAL.

text.p: Estonian drinks maker Liviko on Friday said that its first quarter net profit rose 10 percent as shareholders approved plans to boost its share capital.
First quarter profit rose 10 percent to 10.6 million kroons and turnover also rose 10 percent, reaching 115 million kroons.
"Liviko estimates its profit will grow 10 percent this year and the first quarter profits prove that we are on target," chairman Udo Themas told the shareholder meeting.
Shareholders also decided to boost the capital from 37.2 million kroons to 111.8 million kroons by approving a bonus two-for-one share issue worth 74.5 million kroons.
They also approved the profit distrbution, with 4.8 million kroons to be paid out as dividends or 1.30 kroons per share and 8.5 million kroons sent to company reserves.
